jobs.title: Procurement Category Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130115 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As the Procurement Category Manager, you will report to the Head of Strategic Procurement and Responsible Sourcing and will contribute to the Maison's global procurement strategy, being responsible for defining and managing the procurement strategy across the full scope of indirect categories (Events, Digital, Content, Facilities Management, etc.). The objective is to optimize value, reduce costs, manage supplier risks, and ensure compliance, while supporting the strategic objectives of our Maison. Key 
• Responsibilities: Category Strategy Definition and Implementation: Develop and execute procurement strategy for indirect categories, in alignment with the Maison's global Procurement strategy and Group Procurement guidelines. As an expert and advisor on best procurement practices, define optimal, value-driven ways of working with internal Business Owners to increase efficiency. Internal Stakeholder Management: Establish and maintain strong collaboration with internal Business Owners to understand their needs and provide effective procurement support for their projects Ensure the adoption of Procurement policy and Group guidelines by internal teams Collaborate closely with Group Procurement teams and Maisons to foster synergies Supplier Management, Negotiation, and Risk Management: Contribute to suppliers sourcing and ensure Request for Information/Proposal (RFI/RFP) processes Negotiate contractual terms and conditions to secure the best possible terms for the Maison and coordinate the contractualization process with Group Legal Manage risks related to suppliers and contracts Analysis and Reporting : Monitor and report on category performance (savings, cost avoidance etc.) and propose new KPIs Consolidate a follow-up report including all the categories and prepare presentations for management on strategies, achievements, and challenges HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Minimum 5 to 7 years of significant experience in strategic procurement, including at least 3-5 years in indirect categories management, ideally within an international group Excellent communication and influencing abilities, with a capacity to interact at all levels of the organization Proven ability to lead complex tenders and projects and high-level negotiations Team spirit and leadership Results-oriented, problem-solving mindset, proactive, and autonomous Fluent in both French and English STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! In qualità di responsabile della categoria di appalti, riferirai al responsabile degli appalti strategici e del responsabile del settore e contribuirà alla strategia globale per gli appalti della Maison, essendo responsabile della definizione e della gestione della strategia di appalto attraverso tutta l'ambito delle categorie indirette (Eventi, Digitali, Contenuti, Gestione delle strutture, ecc.). L'obiettivo è ottimizzare il valore, ridurre i costi, gestire i rischi dei fornitori e garantire la conformità, sostenendo al contempo gli obiettivi strategici della nostra Maison. Chiave
• Responsabilità: Definizione e attuazione della strategia di categoria: elaborare ed attuare una strategia di appalto per le categorie indirette, in linea con la strategia globale di appalto della Maison e gli orientamenti per gli appalti di gruppo. In qualità di esperto e consulente sulle migliori pratiche di appalto, definire modi ottimali e basati sul valore di lavorare con i proprietari aziendali interni per aumentare l'efficienza. Gestione interna delle parti interessate: istituire e mantenere una forte collaborazione con i proprietari interni di Business per comprendere le loro esigenze e fornire un efficace supporto per l'approvvigionamento dei loro progetti Assicurare l'adozione di politiche di approvvigionamento e linee guida di Gruppo da parte di squadre interne di gruppo dialogate strettamente con i gruppi di approvvigionamento e le Maisons per promuovere sinergie Gestione Fornitore, Negoziazione e Gestione del Rischio: contribuire ai fornitori approvvigionamento e garantire i processi di Richiesta di informazioni/Proposta (RFI/RFP) Negoziare le condizioni contrattuali per garantire i migliori termini possibili per la Maison e coordinare il processo di contrattualizzazione con il Gruppo Legale Gestire i rischi relativi a fornitori e contratti Analisi e reporting: monitorare e riferire sulle prestazioni di categoria (risparmi, risparmi, costi di evasione ecc.) e proporre nuovi KPI Consolidare un rapporto di follow-up che includa tutte le categorie e preparare presentazioni per la gestione su strategie, realizzazioni e sfide COME VOI ESPREDERE SUCCESSO CON NOI? Minimo 5-7 anni di esperienza significativa nell'approvvigionamento strategico, compresi almeno 3-5 anni di gestione delle categorie indirette, idealmente all'interno di un gruppo internazionale Eccellente comunicazione e capacità di influenza, con una capacità di interagire a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione Provoca capacità di condurre gare e progetti complessi e negoziati di alto livello spirito di squadra e leadership Risultati orientati, mentalità problem-solving, proattivo e autonomo Fluente sia in francese che in inglese STILL WONDING Why you should apply? Un team di benvenuto: unisciti al nostro team amichevole, aperto e di talento, dove le tue competenze saranno valutate e i tuoi contributi faranno una vera differenza. Lavoro dinamico e coinvolgente: esperienza quotidiana di attività interessanti, impegnative e diversificate, mantenendoti impegnato e motivato. Investimenti nella tua crescita: Siamo appassionati di sviluppare le nostre persone, e avrai accesso a varie opportunità di formazione e sviluppo per migliorare le tue competenze e far progredire la tua carriera. La cultura Piaget di incoraggiare Extra-Care, promuovere la Maestria e far emergere lo straordinario nella nostra gente, significa che andremo sempre oltre, facendo ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima. Insieme. Se volete diventare parte di esso non esitate a fare domanda! descriptionByLocale.de:
Referenzcode: JR130115 Umgeben von seiner Familie und geleitet von seiner starken unternehmerischen Einstellung beschloss Georges-Edouard Piaget 1874, in La Côte-aux-Fées, einem kleinen Dorf mitten in den Schweizer Bergen des Jura, eine Uhrmacherwerkstatt zu gründen. Seit diesem Tag hat Piaget die Grenzen geschoben, um das, was noch nie zuvor getan wurde, zu tun, und anspruchsvolle und extravagante Uhren und Schmuckkreationen zu schmieden. Innerhalb der Mauern unserer Ateliers de l,Extraordinaire, nutzen unsere Meisterhandwerker weiterhin seltene Fähigkeiten, die von Generation zu Generation erhalten und perfektioniert wurden. Heute wird Piaget, eine außergewöhnliche Handwerkskunst, weltweit gefeiert, unterstützt von einer starken globalen Präsenz und einem engagierten Netzwerk von Kundensupport und Retail-Kollegen, die den Geist unseres Maison jeden Tag zum Leben erwecken. WIE WIRD EIN IMPACT GESCHAFFEN? Als Kategoriemanager für Beschaffungen berichten Sie dem Leiter der Abteilung Strategische Beschaffung und verantwortungsvolle Beschaffung und tragen zur globalen Beschaffungsstrategie des Maison bei, die für die Festlegung und Verwaltung der Beschaffungsstrategie im gesamten Bereich indirekter Kategorien (Events, Digital, Content, Facilities Management, etc.) zuständig ist. Ziel ist es, den Wert zu optimieren, Kosten zu senken, Lieferantenrisiken zu verwalten und die Einhaltung der strategischen Ziele unseres Maison zu gewährleisten. Key
• Verantwortung: Kategorie Strategie Definition und Umsetzung: Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Beschaffungsstrategie für indirekte Kategorien, in Übereinstimmung mit der globalen Beschaffungsstrategie und den Leitlinien für die Beschaffung von Gruppen. Als Experte und Berater für die besten Beschaffungspraktiken definieren Sie optimale, wertorientierte Wege, mit internen Business Owners zusammenzuarbeiten, um die Effizienz zu steigern. Internes Kartenhaltermanagement: Aufbau und Pflege einer starken Zusammenarbeit mit internen Business Owners, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und eine effektive Unterstützung ihrer Projekte zu bieten Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Beschaffungspolitik und die Gruppenrichtlinien von internen Teams angenommen werden Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams und Maisons für die Beschaffung von Unternehmensteilen, um Synergien zu fördern Lieferantenmanagement, Verhandlungen und Risikomanagement: Beitrag für Lieferanten Beschaffung und Sicherstellung der Anfrage nach Informationen/Vorschlägen (RFI/RFP) Prozesse Verhandeln Sie vertragliche Bedingungen, um die bestmöglichen Bedingungen für das Maison zu sichern und koordinieren den Vertragsprozess mit Group Legal Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Lieferanten und Verträgen verwalten Analyse und Reporting: Überwachen und berichten über die Kategorieleistung (Sparen, Kostenvermeidung etc.) und neue KPIs vorschlagen Konsolidieren Sie einen Follow-up-Bericht mit allen Kategorien und bereiten Sie Präsentationen für das Management über Strategien, Erfolge und Herausforderungen vor WIE WIRD SIE MIT UNS AUSFÜHREN? Mindestens 5 bis 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Beschaffung, einschließlich mindestens 3-5 Jahre in indirekten Kategorien Management, ideal innerhalb einer internationalen Gruppe Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und Einflussfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zu interagieren Bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Ausschreibungen und Projekte und Verhandlungen auf hoher Ebene Teamgeist und Führung Ergebnisorientierte, Problemlösungs-Gedanken, proaktive und autonome Fluent in Französisch und Englisch STILL WONDERING WARUM SIE SOLLTEN APPLY? jobs.title: Supply Chain Solutions Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130113 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Start date: September 2026 Duration: 6 months As a Supply Chain Solutions Engineer within Cartier Operations' Execution Excellence Team, you will be a key player in shaping the future of our data-driven strategy. You'll be instrumental in building and enhancing our data environment, impacting everything from datasets and dataflows to dashboards and automation. This is a high-impact role where you will directly contribute to the continuous improvement of our supply chain operations through innovative solutions and cross-functional collaboration. You will be at the forefront of developing and implementing our low-code communication workflow tool, taking ownership of the entire delivery process – from requirements definition and tool selection to end-user training and ongoing support. You will also establish and maintain best practices, creating valuable learning materials to ensure the ongoing success of our initiatives. This is an opportunity to make a significant contribution to a world-renowned luxury brand, driving efficiency and innovation within a dynamic and collaborative team. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Pega Systems Developer within our Supply Chain Solutions Team, you will play a pivotal role in transforming our business operations by designing and implementing cutting-edge digital case management solutions. You will be working at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the power of Pega to streamline workflows, enhance efficiency, and drive significant improvements across the organization. Your contributions will directly impact our ability to deliver exceptional results and maintain our position as a global leader. Your Key 
• Responsibilities: Solution Design & Development: Collaborating closely with diverse stakeholders (including Supply Chain and other departments), you will meticulously analyze business needs, define comprehensive business cases, and design robust, scalable workflows within the Pega platform. This includes: Conducting thorough requirements gathering sessions, utilizing various techniques such as workshops and interviews to fully understand stakeholder needs and translate them into functional specifications. Developing and maintaining detailed design documentation, ensuring clarity and consistency across all aspects of the solution. Implementing and testing Pega applications, adhering to best practices for software engineering, version control, and continuous integration. Supervising the development process, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to quality standards. Creating comprehensive user documentation and training materials to support the adoption and ongoing use of the new systems. Process Optimization & Automation: As a member of the Execution Excellence Team, you will be a key driver of process improvement initiatives. This involves: Identifying and analyzing non-value-added processes, proposing innovative solutions for optimization and automation using Pega's capabilities. Developing and implementing automated workflows to streamline operations, reduce manual effort, and minimize errors. Monitoring and evaluating the performance of implemented solutions, identifying areas for further improvement and making necessary adjustments. Contributing to the ongoing development and refinement of our process improvement methodologies. Stakeholder Management & Communication: Effective communication is crucial in this role. You will: Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across various departments, ensuring alignment on project goals and objectives. Proactively communicate project updates, progress, and challenges to stakeholders, keeping them informed and engaged throughout the process. Present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, to both technical and non-technical audiences. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You are in last year of an engineering school in Supply Chain or any similar scientific field. You have a good understanding of BI tools, data architecture and overall ERP systems (SAP is a plus). You are familiar with low-code applications (Power Automate, Sales Force, Pega is a plus). You are interested in market-leading front-end and web development solutions (CSS, REACT, JavaScript is a plus) You are pro-active, curious, and familiar with the agile methodology (Jira knowledge is a plus). You have excellent communication skills, with both technical and non-technical teams. You are fluent both in French and English. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING? In a young and dynamic team focused on personal development (trainings, conferences, certifications, etc.), you will take part of Cartier’s Execution Excellence journey. You will work on all product lines with all our regions and markets for a leading Company in the luxury industry. descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Codice di riferimento: JR130113 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutti i Métiers dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall’impegno per l’eccellenza, cercando di arricchire continuamente il patrimonio della Maison spingendo i confini della creatività e dell’innovazione. Data di inizio: settembre 2026 Durata: 6 mesi In qualità di ingegnere di soluzioni per la supply chain all'interno del team di eccellenza dell'esecuzione di Cartier Operations, sarai un giocatore chiave nella definizione del futuro della nostra strategia basata sui dati. Sarete strumentali nella costruzione e nel miglioramento del nostro ambiente di dati, influenzando tutto, dai dataset e dai flussi di dati alle dashboard e all'automazione. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto che contribuisce direttamente al miglioramento continuo delle nostre operazioni di supply chain attraverso soluzioni innovative e collaborazione interfunzionale. Sarete in prima linea nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione del nostro strumento di flusso di lavoro di comunicazione a basso codice, che prende la proprietà dell'intero processo di consegna, dalla definizione dei requisiti e dalla selezione degli strumenti alla formazione degli utenti finali e al supporto continuo. Potrai anche stabilire e mantenere le migliori pratiche, creando materiali di apprendimento preziosi per garantire il successo continuo delle nostre iniziative. Questa è un'opportunità per dare un contributo significativo a un marchio di lusso di fama mondiale, alla guida dell'efficienza e dell'innovazione all'interno di un team dinamico e collaborativo. Responsabilità - Solution Design & Development: Collaborando a stretto contatto con diversi stakeholder (tra cui Supply Chain e altri dipartimenti), analizzare meticolosamente le esigenze aziendali, definire casi aziendali completi e progettare flussi di lavoro robusti e scalabili all'interno della piattaforma Pega. - Condurre i requisiti approfonditi che raccolgono sessioni, utilizzando varie tecniche come workshop e interviste per comprendere pienamente le esigenze degli stakeholder e tradurli in specifiche funzionali. - Sviluppare e mantenere una documentazione dettagliata di progettazione, garantendo chiarezza e coerenza in tutti gli aspetti della soluzione. - Implementare e testare le applicazioni Pega, aderendo alle migliori pratiche per l'ingegneria del software, il controllo delle versioni e l'integrazione continua. - supervisionare il processo di sviluppo, garantire la consegna tempestiva e l'aderenza agli standard di qualità. - Creazione di documentazione completa dell'utente e materiali di formazione per supportare l'adozione e l'utilizzo in corso dei nuovi sistemi. - Ottimizzazione dei processi e automazione: identificazione e analisi di processi non-valore aggiunto, proponendo soluzioni innovative per l'ottimizzazione e l'automazione utilizzando le capacità di Pega. - Sviluppare e implementare flussi di lavoro automatizzati per semplificare le operazioni, ridurre lo sforzo manuale e minimizzare gli errori. - Monitoraggio e valutazione delle prestazioni delle soluzioni implementate, identificazione delle aree per un ulteriore miglioramento e adeguamento necessario. - Contribuire allo sviluppo e alla perfezionamento continuo delle nostre metodologie di miglioramento dei processi. - Stakeholder Management & Communication: Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con gli stakeholder di vari dipartimenti, garantendo l'allineamento sugli obiettivi e gli obiettivi del progetto. - Proattivamente comunicare gli aggiornamenti, i progressi e le sfide dei progetti agli stakeholder, tenendoli informati e impegnati in tutto il processo. - Presenti risultati e raccomandazioni chiaramente e concisamente, sia verbalmente che per iscritto, sia al pubblico tecnico che non tecnico.
• Requisiti - Sei nell'ultimo anno di una scuola di ingegneria in Supply Chain o in qualsiasi campo scientifico simile. - No. Hai una buona comprensione degli strumenti BI, dell'architettura dei dati e dei sistemi ERP globali (SAP è un plus). - No. Hai familiarità con le applicazioni di basso codice (Power Automate, Sales Force, Pega è un plus). - No. Sei interessato a soluzioni di front-end e sviluppo web leader di mercato (CSS, REACT, JavaScript è un plus). - No. Siete proattivi, curiosi e familiari con la metodologia agile (la conoscenza di Jira è un plus). - No. Hai ottime capacità di comunicazione, con team tecnici e non tecnici. - No. Sei fluente sia in francese che in inglese.
• Cosa offriamo - In un team giovane e dinamico focalizzato sullo sviluppo personale (formazione, conferenze, certificazioni, ecc.), si parte del viaggio di Esecuzione Eccellenza di Cartier. - No. Si lavorerà su tutte le linee di prodotto con tutte le nostre regioni e mercati per una società leader nel settore del lusso. Referenzcode: JR130113 Die Geschichte von Cartier basiert auf Neugier und Leidenschaft. Seit mehr als 170 Jahren haben wir einen mutigen Pioniergeist, der unsere Teams in allen Métiers von unseren Boutiquen bis zu unseren Werkstätten und Firmenbüros inspiriert. Unsere mehr als 10.000 Kollegen aus mehr als 105 Nationalitäten sind durch einen gemeinsamen unabhängigen Geist und Engagement für Exzellenz vereint und streben danach, das Erbe unseres Hauses kontinuierlich zu bereichern, indem wir die Grenzen von Kreativität und Innovation überschreiten. Startdatum: September 2026 Dauer: 6 Monate Als Supply Chain Solutions Engineer im Execution Excellence Team von Cartier Operations sind Sie ein wichtiger Akteur bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft unserer datengesteuerten Strategie. Sie sind maßgeblich am Aufbau und der Verbesserung unserer Datenumgebung beteiligt und beeinflussen alles von Datensätzen und Datenflüssen bis hin zu Dashboards und Automatisierung. Dies ist eine wichtige Rolle, bei der Sie direkt zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Lieferkettenaktivitäten durch innovative Lösungen und funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit beitragen. Sie sind an vorderster Front bei der Entwicklung und Implementierung unseres Low-Code-Kommunikations-Workflow-Tools und übernehmen die Verantwortung für den gesamten Bereitstellungsprozess - von der Anforderungsdefinition und -auswahl bis hin zu Endnutzerschulungen und laufendem Support. Sie werden auch Best Practices etablieren und pflegen und wertvolle Lernmaterialien erstellen, um den anhaltenden Erfolg unserer Initiativen sicherzustellen. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, einen bedeutenden Beitrag zu einer weltweit anerkannten Luxusmarke zu leisten und Effizienz und Innovation in einem dynamischen und kooperativen Team voranzutreiben. Responsabilità - Solution Design & Development: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern (einschließlich Supply Chain und anderen Abteilungen) analysieren Sie die Geschäftsanforderungen sorgfältig, definieren umfassende Business Cases und entwerfen robuste, skalierbare Workflows innerhalb der Pega-Plattform. - Durchführung gründlicher Anforderungserfassungssitzungen unter Verwendung verschiedener Techniken wie Workshops und Interviews, um die Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder vollständig zu verstehen und sie in funktionale Spezifikationen zu übersetzen. - Entwicklung und Pflege einer detaillierten Designdokumentation, um Klarheit und Konsistenz in allen Aspekten der Lösung zu gewährleisten. Implementierung und Testen von Pega-Anwendungen unter Einhaltung von Best Practices für Software-Engineering, Versionskontrolle und kontinuierliche Integration. - Überwachung des Entwicklungsprozesses, Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Lieferung und Einhaltung der Qualitätsstandards. Erstellung umfassender Benutzerdokumentationen und Schulungsmaterialien zur Unterstützung der Einführung und der laufenden Nutzung der neuen Systeme. - Prozessoptimierung & Automatisierung: Identifizierung und Analyse von Prozessen ohne Mehrwert, Vorschlag innovativer Lösungen für Optimierung und Automatisierung unter Nutzung der Fähigkeiten von Pega. - Entwicklung und Implementierung automatisierter Workflows, um den Betrieb zu optimieren, den manuellen Aufwand zu reduzieren und Fehler zu minimieren. - Überwachung und Bewertung der Leistung implementierter Lösungen, Ermittlung von Bereichen für weitere Verbesserungen und Durchführung notwendiger Anpassungen. - Beitrag zur laufenden Entwicklung und Verfeinerung unserer Methoden zur Prozessverbesserung. Stakeholder Management & Kommunikation: Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu Stakeholdern in verschiedenen Abteilungen und Gewährleistung der Ausrichtung auf Projektziele. - Projektaktualisierungen, -fortschritte und -herausforderungen proaktiv an die Stakeholder kommunizieren und diese während des gesamten Prozesses auf dem Laufenden halten. - Präsentieren Sie die Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen klar und prägnant, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich, sowohl für das technische als auch für das nichttechnische Publikum.
• Requisiti - Sie sind im letzten Jahr einer Ingenieurschule in Supply Chain oder einem ähnlichen wissenschaftlichen Bereich. - Sie haben ein gutes Verständnis für BI-Tools, Datenarchitektur und gesamte ERP-Systeme (SAP ist ein Plus). - Sie kennen Low-Code-Anwendungen (Power Automate, Sales Force, Pega ist ein Plus). - Sie interessieren sich für marktführende Frontend- und Webentwicklungslösungen (CSS, REACT, JavaScript ist ein Plus). - Sie sind proaktiv, neugierig und mit der agilen Methodik vertraut (Jira-Wissen ist ein Plus). - Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl mit technischen als auch mit nicht-technischen Teams. - Sie sprechen fließend Französisch und Englisch.
• Cosa offriamo - In einem jungen und dynamischen Team, das sich auf die persönliche Entwicklung konzentriert (Trainings, Konferenzen, Zertifizierungen usw.), nehmen Sie an Cartiers Execution Excellence-Reise teil. - Sie werden an allen Produktlinien mit allen unseren Regionen und Märkten für ein führendes Unternehmen in der Luxusbranche arbeiten. jobs.title: Anaplan Model Builder
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130201 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. As one of the core building block of the Cartier Data Office, Connected Planning is a critical, yet rapidly expending part of our Data ecosystem. The Anaplan model builder has a key role in the development of the solution within the Maison and the maintenance of the models ensuring operational efficiency and business continuity. As a model builder, you will ensure that models used Maison-wide are matching industry standard best practices and delivering the best level of performance and robustness. How will you make an impact? You will have the following responsibilities: Model building Implement best practices for model development, including version control, documentation and technical optimizations. Proactively keep a high level of technical expertise, and stay up to date with latest developments of the Solution. Ensure robustness and perennity of the models. Ensure data integrity, accuracy and reliability within the models. Maintain comprehensive documentation including design specifications, formulas, and assumptions. Maintenance Investigate and resolve issues related to Anaplan models, including data inconsistencies, formula errors, and system performance. Provide support to end-users. New projects Collaborate with business stakeholders from different department of the Maison. Work with project teams to understand their challenges and requirements. Dès votre arrivée, vous serez plongé dans notre monde enchanteur avec des formations sur notre histoire, notre savoir-faire et nos créations. Tout au long du processus de recrutement, vous rencontrerez le responsable CRC et le directeur E-business. Dans le cas contraire, vous recevrez un email pour vous informer que votre candidature n'a pas été retenue. jobs.description: Reference code: JR130276 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? You will work within Group Supply Chain Execution team to enrich the new Supply Chain Knowledge platform for Watch and Jewelry Maisons, interacting directly with them to build the right approach for publishing and enhancing Group Operating Model knowledge and ensuring W&J business continuity through it. You will be involved in various ongoing projects to be able to capitalize on documentation and allow the W&J knowledge to spread through the various Group Supply Chain actors in a more structured way and better user accessibility. You will also deliver the documentation within the appropriate tools, validate each key processes with Maisons and experts, and support the final publication on the platform, looking for a “User buy-in” of this reshuffled and completed documentation platform WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE? You will bring: your desire to explore the Supply Chain end-to-end business models, procedures, and best practices of our Watch & Jewelry Maisons your appetence for detailed process mapping and for tools associated. your soft skills to interact with the Supply Chain departments of our W&J Maisons, IT department, and Richemont Group technical experts. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCESS WITH US? You will work with diverse teams and have the opportunity to learn about a wide variety of domains. You will gain insights into the luxury industry from the perspective of one of the global leaders that is bridging more than two hundred years of heritage with cutting edge innovation. Working in the close to the Swiss countryside right outside Fribourg, we offer an on-site restaurant, a beautiful setting, and a spacious open-plan working environment. The offices are close to local transport with direct access to the train station. #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Supply Chain Solutions Engineer Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Cartier Upstream Supply Chain Project Intern Save Bellevue, Switzerland Richemont Supply Chain Planning Intern Save Villars Sur Glâne, Switzerland Cartier

jobs.title: Stagiaire Concept Innovant
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130371 The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Missions Pour développer notre offre produit, nous recherchons un-e stagiaire pour nous accompagner dans nos pré études de nouveaux concept de montres. Vous ferez partie intégrante d’une petite équipe dynamique dans laquelle vous pourrez développer vos talents. Vous aurez pour mission de mener à bien des projets Innovant permettant de créer de nouvelles esthétiques, d’inventer de nouveaux concepts horloger ou de développer de nouveaux matériaux. Responsabilités Proposer des solutions répondant au principe de concept de nouvelles montres : Amener les solutions à maturité produit et de permettre l’intégration de la solution dans la montre Assurer l’adéquation des solutions avec les concepts Définir les meilleurs acteurs et/ou moyens pour la mise en place de ces technologies Mettre en place les moyens nécessaires pour répondre à la faisabilité des concepts : Proposer des solutions techniques rendant réalisables le développement de produits Construire les solutions, Définir les process et plan d’expérience nécessaire Valider les solutions et les résultats avec les parties intéressées Assurer le suivi et la collaboration avec d’autres départements (création, bureau technique, marketing, etc) Homologuer les solutions d’après les exigences de qualité requises Cadrage et communication : Cadrer les partenariats avec les différents intervenants Cadrer les projets sur le passage des jalons et du timing ainsi que sur le plan juridique en assurer la confidentialité Communiquer sur l’avancement des projets et sur les solutions techniques CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Formation en ingénierie, avec une orientation en recherche & innovation ou équivalent Personne créative, force de proposition et possédant de bonnes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes Esprit d’équipe, capacité d’adaptation, autonomie Maîtrise du logiciel Creo (CAO) est un atout VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Nous vous invitons à soumettre votre candidature complète directement sur notre site carrières. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous recevrez une invitation pour un entretien vidéo différé. Ce sera l'occasion de vous présenter, d'exprimer vos motivations et de partager vos attentes. Notre équipe RH analysera ensuite votre entretien. Si votre candidature est retenue, vous recevrez, quelques jours avant le 1er octobre 2026, une invitation pour notre Talents Day, notre journée de recrutement 100% digitale. À cette occasion, une offre de stage spécifiquement adaptée à votre profil vous sera également proposée. #WeAreCartier#TalentDay Cette journée immersive au cœur de l'univers Cartier vous permettra de rencontrer un(e) référent(e) RH et un(e) manager. Vous participerez à une étude de cas en groupe, suivie d'un entretien individuel. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130371 La storia di Cartier è fondata su curiosità e passione. Da oltre 170 anni abbiamo abbracciato uno spirito coraggioso e pionieristico che continua a ispirare i nostri team di tutte le Professioni dalle nostre boutique ai nostri laboratori e uffici aziendali. I nostri 10.000+ colleghi di oltre 105 nazionalità sono uniti da uno spirito indipendente condiviso e dall'impegno per l'eccellenza, colpendo per arricchire continuamente la nostra Maison COSA SUL OFFERTA A Cartier, si integrerà una comunità unita da un forte senso di responsabilità, dove la connessione, la collaborazione e lo spirito collettivo fioriscono. Apprezziamo l'individualità dei nostri talenti, spinti da un impegno comune all'eccellenza, ispirato alla diversità delle culture del mondo, e impegnati a rispettare e arricchire il nostro patrimonio unico. Siamo convinti che diverse prospettive promuovano l'innovazione e ci incoraggiano a creare esperienze eccezionali. Vi offriamo un ambiente stimolante e l'opportunità di contribuire, attraverso la vostra visione personale, ad un patrimonio di creatività. Celebriamo tutti i successi, qualunque cosa siano, promuovendo così legami significativi basati sulla reciproca gratitudine e sostegno e coltivando un forte senso di appartenenza. Unisciti a noi a Cartier, un luogo unico e in continua evoluzione. Che cosa sarà il tuo IMPACT? Missioni Per sviluppare la nostra offerta di prodotti, stiamo cercando un tirocinante per accompagnarci nella nostra pre-studio del nuovo concetto di orologio. Sarete parte integrante di un piccolo team dinamico in cui potrete sviluppare i vostri talenti. La vostra missione sarà di realizzare progetti innovativi per creare nuove estetiche, inventare nuovi concetti di orologeria o per sviluppare nuovi materiali. Responsabilità Proporre soluzioni in linea con il concetto di nuovi orologi: portare soluzioni alla maturità del prodotto e permettere l'integrazione della soluzione nell'orologio Assicurare l'adeguatezza delle soluzioni con i concetti Definire i migliori attori e/o mezzi per l'implementazione di queste tecnologie Impostare i mezzi necessari per soddisfare la fattibilità dei concetti: Proporre soluzioni tecniche che rendono possibile lo sviluppo dei prodotti Soluzioni per l'edilizia, Definire i processi e il piano di esperienza necessari Soluzioni di convalida e risultati con le parti interessate Monitoraggio e collaborazione con altri dipartimenti (creazione, ufficio tecnico, marketing, ecc.) Soluzioni di supporto basate sui requisiti di qualità Benchmarking e comunicazione: partnership quadro con diversi stakeholder Progetti quadro su pietre miliari e tempi nonché riservatezza legale Comunicare sui progressi del progetto e soluzioni tecniche COSA RECOGNIZE Formazione di ingegneria, con orientamento di ricerca e innovazione o persona creativa equivalente, forza di proposta e buone capacità di analisi e problem solving Spirito di squadra, adattabilità, autonomia Software Management Creo (CAO) è un bene TUA ESPERIENZA CON US Se il tuo profilo soddisfa le nostre aspettative, riceverai un invito per un'intervista video ritardata. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif. Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles. Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité. Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance. Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution. QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ? Missions Au sein de la direction Excellence Opérationnelle de Cartier Industrie, nous recherchons un.e stagiaire pour nous accompagner dans nos initiatives stratégiques en Lean Manufacturing et développement industriel. Vous ferez partie intégrante d’une petite équipe dynamique dans laquelle vous pourrez développer vos talents. Vous aurez pour mission de mener à bien des projets d’amélioration continue pour nos Manufactures Horlogerie et Joaillerie. Ces projets visent à renforcer les synergies entre les Manufactures Cartier dans les 3 pays concernés (Suisse, France et Italie). Responsabilités Participation à des missions d’appui aux pôles horlogerie, joaillerie et accessoires Soutien à la coordination et au suivi de projets stratégiques Appui au développement de l’écosystème de fournisseurs et partenaires Expérimentation et intégration d'innovations au sein de l'équipe Excellence Opérationnelle, avec un accent particulier sur les applications d'intelligence artificielle CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS Formation en ingénierie, avec spécialisation IA, transformation digitale et/ou génie industriel (le stage pourra être soit à dominante data / soit à dominante génie industriel – la capacité à faire les 2 est un atout) Stage Bac+5/fin d’études Personne autonome, organisée, curieuse et proactive Esprit d’équipe et appréciant collaborer avec des interlocuteurs diversifiés Compétences data – et idéalement en IA La maîtrise de l’anglais et/ou de l’italien représentent un atout Intérêt pour l’horlogerie et la joaillerie VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS Nous vous invitons à soumettre votre candidature complète directement sur notre site carrières. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous recevrez une invitation pour un entretien vidéo différé. Ce sera l'occasion de vous présenter, d'exprimer vos motivations et de partager vos attentes. Notre équipe RH analysera ensuite votre entretien. Si votre candidature est retenue, vous recevrez, quelques jours avant le 1er octobre 2026, une invitation pour notre Talents Day, notre journée de recrutement 100% digitale. À cette occasion, une offre de stage spécifiquement adaptée à votre profil vous sera également proposée. #WeAreCartier#TalentDay Cette journée immersive au cœur de l'univers Cartier vous permettra de rencontrer un(e) référent(e) RH et un(e) manager. Vous participerez à une étude de cas en groupe, suivie d'un entretien individuel. Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier. jobs.title: - Business Analyst Intern, TimeVallée
jobs.description: Reference code: JR130546 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Business Analyst Intern Starting Date: September Duration: 6 months (100%, full-time) Location: Bellevue, GE, CH YOU WANT TO: Discover a unique distribution brand Improve your business & commercial know-how in a fast-paced & agile environment Support a wide range of topics (distribution, performance, operations…) with a varied list stakeholders, including other functions, Maisons & retailers Then you must be the right talent to join TimeVallée! Launched in 2014, TimeVallée is a visionary multi-brand watch retail concept offering a curated selection of the most prestigious watchmaking Maisons with a complete range of experiences and services. Fully operated by strategic partners, TimeVallée’s mission is to provide a complete turnkey solution: a 360 brand concept to support the Maison and retail partners , a customer-centric approach to maximize engagement and retention, cross-industry partnerships & unique experiences to boost client acquisition while always looking at excellence in execution. With more than 50 stores worldwide, TimeVallée is the only multi-brand with a global presence and its ambition is to drive a qualitative and sustainable network growth. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? Reporting to the Business Performance & Development Manager, you will be assisting the team as follows: Support the timely delivery & accuracy of recurring/ad-hoc presentations and analyses responding to TimeVallée business priorities Prepare templates, research, export and consolidate data for analysis for deployment to maisons, retailers, other group functions and top management Ensure the updates, maintenance and improvements of various TimeVallée commercial files Document existing business processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness This is a unique opportunity to learn from both the strategic perspective of our headquarters team and the practical realities of working directly with our retail partners, Maisons and other group functions, providing a well-rounded learning experience. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Enrolled in a Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field First experience as a business analyst or similar role Fluency in English Excellent proficiency in Excel & PowerPoint Prior experience working with data visualization tools, looker is a plus Proactivity, entrepreneurship & team spirit with ability to work independently Business oriented with analytical skills Available for a 6-month internship starting in September 2026 You have a mandatory internship agreement by your university WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. jobs.title: Group HR Reporting Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130567 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking HR Reporting Manager to strengthen the next chapter of Group HR Reporting. In this role, you will drive reporting excellence across the Group by ensuring reliable, scalable, and business-relevant HR reporting, while helping elevate reporting maturity across HR. You will play a key role in transforming reporting into a more robust, consistent, and value-creating capability, supporting operational decision-making and regulatory requirements. Reporting to the Group People Analytics Director, you will own the delivery and continuous improvement of Group HR Reporting, with a primary focus on Workday reporting while also leveraging data from other HR systems where needed. You will help shape the reporting operating model, strengthen governance and consistency across decentralized reporting activities, and partner closely with Group HR functions, Group Platform teams and HR data stakeholders to ensure reporting remains accurate, scalable, and fit for purpose across the Group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position HR Reporting as a strong operational and business-enabling capability for HR, combining delivery excellence, stakeholder partnership, reporting governance, and continuous improvement. In particular, you will:
• Own the end-to-end delivery of standardized HR reporting across the Group, ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely outputs for recurring reporting cycles and ad hoc business needs.
• Lead the industrialization, simplification, and automation of reporting processes to improve reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
• Define and maintain Group HR reporting standards, including reporting definitions, calculation methodologies, logic, and hierarchies.
• Establish and continuously strengthen the Workday reporting governance and operating model, ensuring clear accountability, controlled access, consistent development practices, and sustainable delivery across centralized and decentralized teams.
• Supervise the broader reporting landscape across HR to secure consistency, avoid uncontrolled proliferation of local reporting practices, and maintain visibility over reporting outputs produced across the organization.
• Partner closely with Group HR functional leads to understand business challenges and translate them into clear, relevant, and actionable reporting outputs.
• Work closely with Group Platform and Data teams to ensure scalability, robustness, and technical consistency of reporting solutions.
• Own the preparation of regulated, controlled, or external HR disclosures, including full responsibility for non-financial reporting and other official reporting requirements.
• Drive the HR reporting roadmap and lead the prioritization of reporting improvements and enhancements in line with business needs and Group priorities.
• Leverage the Group Product Operating Model and Agile methodology to drive the delivery of reporting enhancements, ensuring alignment between business priorities, capacity, and execution.
• Promote adoption of self-service reporting solutions by improving accessibility, usability, and trust in reporting tools across the HR community.
• Animate the HR reporting community around effective practices and lead targeted upskilling initiatives, delivering practical guidance to strengthen reporting mastery across HR. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Master’s degree in a relevant field and solid experience in HR reporting, including experience in a complex, international environment.
• Proven expertise in Workday reporting, including report design, reporting governance, security considerations, and operating model definition.
• Familiarity with Product Operating Models and Agile ways of working, with the ability to effectively manage demand, priorities, and delivery in a fast-paced environment.
• Proven experience handling regulated reporting and audits, with a high level of rigor in traceability, documentation, controls, and quality assurance.
• Strong understanding of HR data structures and reporting logic.
• Ability to combine strong hands-on delivery capability with a broader view of reporting architecture, governance, and service scalability.
• Strong collaboration mindset and ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization, navigating ambiguity with structure, pragmatism, and clarity.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with a clear pedagogical mindset to support adoption and capability building.
• Strong solution-oriented mindset with a proactive, “can-do” attitude, able to navigate complexity, resolve issues pragmatically, and drive topics to closure.
• Strong attention to detail, structured problem-solving capabilities, and a high level of ownership in environments where accuracy, consistency, and reliability are critical.
• Fluent in English; French is an asset.. WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT? Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential. - We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity. - We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity. - We care for the world we live in. YOUR JOURNEY WITH US If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role #Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture Similar Jobs Snr HR Manager, People Ops & Compliance Save Singapore, Singapore Richemont New Foundations - S4HANA Transformation Technical Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont New Foundations Programme Manager Save Meyrin, Switzerland Richemont

descriptionByLocale.it:
Codice di riferimento: JR130567 Richemont possiede alcune delle principali Maison di lusso al mondo, con particolari punti di forza nei gioielli, negli orologi pregiati e negli accessori premium. Ogni Maison rappresenta una tradizione orgogliosa di stile, qualità e artigianalità e Richemont cerca di preservare il patrimonio e l'identità di ciascuna delle sue Maison. Allo stesso tempo, ci impegniamo nell’innovazione e nella progettazione di nuovi prodotti che sono in sintonia con i valori delle nostre Maison, attraverso un processo di continua creatività. Richemont è alla ricerca di un responsabile del reporting HR altamente qualificato e avanzato per rafforzare il prossimo capitolo del Gruppo HR Reporting. In questo ruolo, guiderai l'eccellenza di reporting in tutto il Gruppo assicurando report HR affidabili, scalabili e rilevanti per il business, aiutando al contempo ad elevare la maturità di report nelle risorse umane. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione della reportistica in una capacità più robusta, coerente e di creazione di valore, supportando i requisiti operativi decisionali e normativi. Segnalando al Group People Analytics Director, possiederai la consegna e il miglioramento continuo del Group HR Reporting, con un focus primario sulla reportistica di Workday, sfruttando anche i dati provenienti da altri sistemi HR dove necessario. Aiuterai a plasmare il modello operativo di reportistica, a rafforzare la governance e la coerenza tra le attività di reportistica decentrate e a collaborare strettamente con le funzioni del Gruppo HR, i team di Piattaforma di Gruppo e le parti interessate dei dati HR per garantire la reportistica sia accurata, scalabile e adatta a destinazione in tutto il Gruppo. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In questo ruolo, si posiziona HR Reporting come una forte capacità operativa e business-abilitativa per le risorse umane, combinando l'eccellenza della consegna, il partenariato stakeholder, la governance di report e il miglioramento continuo. In particolare:
• Proprio la consegna end-to-end del reporting HR standardizzato in tutto il Gruppo, garantendo uscite accurate, coerenti e tempestive per i cicli di reporting ricorrenti e le esigenze aziendali ad hoc.
• Condurre l'industrializzazione, semplificazione e automazione dei processi di reporting per migliorare affidabilità, scalabilità ed efficienza.
• Definire e mantenere standard di reporting Gruppo HR, tra cui definizioni di report, metodologie di calcolo, logica e gerarchie.
• Stabilire e rafforzare continuamente la governance di reportistica di Workday e il modello operativo, assicurando una chiara responsabilitÃ, un accesso controllato, pratiche di sviluppo coerenti e una consegna sostenibile in team centralizzati e decentrati.
• Superare il panorama di reporting più ampio attraverso le risorse umane per garantire la coerenza, evitare la proliferazione incontrollata delle pratiche di reporting locali e mantenere la visibilità sui risultati di report prodotti in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con la funzionalità del Gruppo HR porta a comprendere le sfide aziendali e a tradurli in output di reporting chiari, pertinenti e fattibili.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di Group Platform e Data per garantire scalabilità, robustezza e coerenza tecnica delle soluzioni di reporting.
• Possiede la preparazione di informazioni regolamentate, controllate o esterne sulle risorse umane, compresa la piena responsabilità per la segnalazione non finanziaria e altri requisiti di reporting ufficiali.
• Guidare la roadmap di reporting HR e guidare la priorità di reporting miglioramenti e miglioramenti in linea con le esigenze aziendali e le priorità del Gruppo.
• Promuovere l'adozione di soluzioni di reporting self-service migliorando l'accessibilità, l'usabilità e la fiducia negli strumenti di reporting in tutta la comunità HR.

Reference code: JR130567 Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity. Richemont is looking for a highly skilled and forward-thinking HR Reporting Manager to strengthen the next chapter of Group HR Reporting. In this role, you will drive reporting excellence across the Group by ensuring reliable, scalable, and business-relevant HR reporting, while helping elevate reporting maturity across HR. You will play a key role in transforming reporting into a more robust, consistent, and value-creating capability, supporting operational decision-making and regulatory requirements. Reporting to the Group People Analytics Director, you will own the delivery and continuous improvement of Group HR Reporting, with a primary focus on Workday reporting while also leveraging data from other HR systems where needed. You will help shape the reporting operating model, strengthen governance and consistency across decentralized reporting activities, and partner closely with Group HR functions, Group Platform teams and HR data stakeholders to ensure reporting remains accurate, scalable, and fit for purpose across the Group. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? In this role, you will position HR Reporting as a strong operational and business-enabling capability for HR, combining delivery excellence, stakeholder partnership, reporting governance, and continuous improvement. In particular, you will:
• Own the end-to-end delivery of standardized HR reporting across the Group, ensuring accurate, consistent, and timely outputs for recurring reporting cycles and ad hoc business needs.
• Lead the industrialization, simplification, and automation of reporting processes to improve reliability, scalability, and efficiency.
• Define and maintain Group HR reporting standards, including reporting definitions, calculation methodologies, logic, and hierarchies.
• Establish and continuously strengthen the Workday reporting governance and operating model, ensuring clear accountability, controlled access, consistent development practices, and sustainable delivery across centralized and decentralized teams.
• Supervise the broader reporting landscape across HR to secure consistency, avoid uncontrolled proliferation of local reporting practices, and maintain visibility over reporting outputs produced across the organization.
• Partner closely with Group HR functional leads to understand business challenges and translate them into clear, relevant, and actionable reporting outputs.
• Work closely with Group Platform and Data teams to ensure scalability, robustness, and technical consistency of reporting solutions.
• Own the preparation of regulated, controlled, or external HR disclosures, including full responsibility for non-financial reporting and other official reporting requirements.
• Drive the HR reporting roadmap and lead the prioritization of reporting improvements and enhancements in line with business needs and Group priorities.
• Leverage the Group Product Operating Model and Agile methodology to drive the delivery of reporting enhancements, ensuring alignment between business priorities, capacity, and execution.
• Promote adoption of self-service reporting solutions by improving accessibility, usability, and trust in reporting tools across the HR community.
• Animate the HR reporting community around effective practices and lead targeted upskilling initiatives, delivering practical guidance to strengthen reporting mastery across HR. HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
• Master’s degree in a relevant field and solid experience in HR reporting, including experience in a complex, international environment.
• Proven expertise in Workday reporting, including report design, reporting governance, security considerations, and operating model definition.
• Familiarity with Product Operating Models and Agile ways of working, with the ability to effectively manage demand, priorities, and delivery in a fast-paced environment.
• Proven experience handling regulated reporting and audits, with a high level of rigor in traceability, documentation, controls, and quality assurance.
• Strong understanding of HR data structures and reporting logic.
• Ability to combine strong hands-on delivery capability with a broader view of reporting architecture, governance, and service scalability.
• Strong collaboration mindset and ability to operate effectively in a matrix organization, navigating ambiguity with structure, pragmatism, and clarity.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with a clear pedagogical mindset to support adoption and capability building.
• Strong solution-oriented mindset with a proactive, “can-do” attitude, able to navigate complexity, resolve issues pragmatically, and drive topics to closure.
• Strong attention to detail, structured problem-solving capabilities, and a high level of ownership in environments where accuracy, consistency, and reliability are critical.

jobs.description: Reference code: JR130767 Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura. Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations. Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation. Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day. HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT? As a Store Planning and Construction Project Manager, you will spearhead the full lifecycle of Piaget's retail development projects across the Europe Region, from design to post-opening. This pivotal role, blending Headquarters and regional responsibilities, ensures both Brand desirability through design excellence and Brand productivity via operational efficiency, quality, cost control, and sustainability. You will be instrumental in delivering the region's retail development and renovation program, upholding brand desirability, execution quality, project planning, budget, and sustainability commitments. Regular travel across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Nordics is essential for site assessments and project oversight. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design: Coordinate design development from concept to construction documentation, ensuring consistency with Piaget's architectural standards and Brand identity. Manage external design specialists (architects, 3D artists, consultants). Collaborate with HQ Retail, VM, and Commercial teams to optimize retail experience and operational efficiency. Budgeting, Planning & Construction: Lead projects from investment validation through construction and close-out, developing and controlling budgets, CAPEX, and planning. Drive tendering, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards. Manage procurement, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, and financial reporting. Coordinate permitting, landlord approvals, and local authority relations. Act as a key stakeholder with Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, and external partners throughout the project. Manage all construction phases, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Piaget's quality and sustainability standards. Risk Management: Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans. Maintenance: Coordinate regional maintenance and post-opening programs, including snagging, retrofit projects, and minor works. Maintain regular communication with Commercial teams and Boutique Directors across Europe. Ensure compliance with Piaget Brand standards, quality, and sustainability objectives. Transversal Management: Act as the primary HQ interface for the Europe Region, coordinating Regional Markets for boutique construction and maintenance. Collaborate closely with internal teams (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) and develop strong relationships with external partners (landlords, consultants, contractors). HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US? Experience: Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Construction Project Management, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Planning and Construction. Proven track record delivering international retail projects within the luxury industry or premium brands. Solid understanding of luxury design, construction processes, and operational excellence. Extensive experience managing Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, General Contractors, and specialist consultants. Strong knowledge of procurement, tender management, commercial negotiations, and cost control. Technical Competencies: Exceptional analytical, planning, and project management skills. Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities. Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite knowledge. Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a significant asset. Strong commercial awareness, proven negotiation skills, and construction cost expertise. Soft Skills: Creative, solution-oriented, and passionate about luxury retail environments, architecture, and design trends. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, effective in multicultural teams. Agile, adaptable, and adept at managing changing priorities and complex stakeholder landscapes. Strong decision-maker with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and a results-oriented, continuous improvement mindset. Highly organized, proactive, and capable of simultaneously managing multiple strategic projects. STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY? A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference. Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated. Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply! descriptionByLocale.it: Codice di riferimento: JR130767 Circondato dalla sua famiglia e guidato dalla sua forte mentalità imprenditoriale, Georges-Edouard Piaget decise, nel 1874, di creare un'officina orologiera a La Côte-aux-Fées, un piccolo villaggio al centro delle montagne svizzere della Giura. Da quel giorno, Piaget ha spinto i limiti a “fare ciò che non è mai stato fatto prima” e artigianale orologi sofisticati e fiammeggianti e creazioni di gioielli. All’interno delle mura dei nostri Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, i nostri maestri artigiani continuano a sfruttare rare abilità che sono state conservate e perfezionate di generazione in generazione. Oggi, l’eccezionale maestria di Piaget è celebrata in tutto il mondo, sostenuta da una forte presenza globale e da una rete dedicata di supporto clienti e colleghi retail che portano lo spirito della nostra Maison alla vita ogni giorno. Come fai a fare un'infezione? In qualità di responsabile del progetto Store Planning and Construction, dirigerai il ciclo di vita completo dei progetti di sviluppo retail di Piaget in tutta Europa, dalla progettazione alla post-apertura. Questo ruolo fondamentale, fondendo le competenze del quartier generale e regionale, assicura sia la disabilità del brand attraverso l'eccellenza del design e la produttività del marchio attraverso l'efficienza operativa, la qualità, il controllo dei costi e la sostenibilità. Sarete strumentali nel fornire il programma di sviluppo e ristrutturazione retail della regione, sostenere la disabilità del marchio, la qualità dell'esecuzione, la pianificazione del progetto, il bilancio e gli impegni di sostenibilità. I viaggi regolari in Francia, Svizzera, Italia e Nordics sono essenziali per la valutazione del sito e la supervisione del progetto. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design: Coordinate lo sviluppo del design dal concept alla documentazione costruttiva, assicurando coerenza con gli standard architettonici di Piaget e l'identità di Brand. Gestire gli specialisti del design esterno (architetti, artisti 3D, consulenti). Collabora con i team HQ Retail, VM e Commercial per ottimizzare l'esperienza di vendita al dettaglio e l'efficienza operativa. Bilancio, Pianificazione & Costruzione: Progetti di piombo dalla convalida degli investimenti attraverso la costruzione e lo close-out, lo sviluppo e il controllo dei bilanci, CAPEX e la pianificazione. Guidare l'appalto, le valutazioni tecniche, i negoziati commerciali e i premi contrattuali. Gestisci gli acquisti, gli ordini di acquisto, gli ordini di cambiamento e la rendicontazione finanziaria. Coordinate permettendo, approvazioni del proprietario, e le relazioni dell'autorità locale. Agire come stakeholder chiave con i partner di Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legale ed Estero in tutto il progetto. Gestisci tutte le fasi di costruzione, assicurando che i progetti vengano consegnati in tempo, all'interno del budget e agli standard di qualità e sostenibilità di Piaget. Gestione del rischio: Identificare i rischi del progetto e implementare piani di mitigazione e recupero. Manutenzione: Coordinare i programmi di manutenzione regionale e post-apertura, inclusi i progetti di snagging, retrofit e le opere minori. Mantenere la comunicazione regolare con i team commerciali e i direttori di boutique in tutta Europa. Garantire il rispetto degli standard, della qualità e degli obiettivi di sostenibilità del marchio Piaget. Transversal Management: Agite come interfaccia principale HQ per la Regione Europa, coordinando i mercati regionali per la costruzione e la manutenzione di boutique. Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team interni (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legale, Finanza, Sicurezza, VM, Contenuti) e sviluppare relazioni forti con i partner esterni (ufficiali, consulenti, appaltatori). Come fai a superare l'esperienza con noi? Esperienza: minimo 10 anni in Architettura, Architettura degli Interni, o Costruzione Project Management, con almeno 7 anni in particolare nella progettazione e costruzione del negozio di lusso. Provato track record che offre progetti di vendita al dettaglio internazionali all'interno del settore di lusso o marchi premium. Solida comprensione del design di lusso, dei processi di costruzione e dell'eccellenza operativa. Ampia esperienza nella gestione di architetti esecutivi, sondaggi quantità, contraenti generali e consulenti specializzati. Forte conoscenza degli appalti, della gestione delle offerte, dei negoziati commerciali e del controllo dei costi. Competenze tecniche: competenze di analisi, pianificazione e gestione del progetto eccezionali. Straordinarie capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e gestione degli stakeholder. Proficienza in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite e conoscenze avanzate di Microsoft Office Suite. La fluenza professionale in inglese e francese è essenziale; le lingue aggiuntive sono un bene significativo. Forte consapevolezza commerciale, comprovate capacità di negoziazione e competenze sui costi di costruzione. Soft Skills: creativo, orientato alla soluzione e appassionato di ambienti di lusso, architettura e tendenze di design. Ottima capacità di collaborazione e comunicazione, efficace in team multiculturali. Agile, adattabile, e adatto a gestire le mutevoli priorità e i paesaggi complessi delle parti interessate. Un decisore forte con un elevato senso di proprietà, responsabilità e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo orientata ai risultati. Altamente organizzato, proattivo e capace di gestire simultaneamente più progetti strategici. Stavo pensando perche' dovresti chiederlo? A Welcoming Team: Unisciti alla nostra squadra amichevole, aperta e di talento, dove le tue abilità saranno valutate e i tuoi contributi faranno una vera differenza. Lavoro dinamico e coinvolgente: sperimentare attività quotidiane che sono interessanti, stimolanti e diversificate, mantenendovi impegnati e motivati. Investimenti nella vostra crescita: Siamo appassionati di sviluppare la nostra gente, e avrete accesso a varie opportunità di formazione e sviluppo per migliorare le vostre abilità e migliorare la vostra carriera. La cultura Piaget di incoraggiare Extra-Care, promuovere la Mastery e far emergere lo Straordinario nel nostro popolo, significa che andremo sempre oltre, facendo “cosa non è mai stato fatto prima”. Insieme. Se si desidera diventare una parte di esso non esitate ad applicare! Als Projektmanager für Store Planning und Construction führen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Einzelhandelsentwicklungsprojekte von Piaget in der gesamten Region Europa an, vom Design bis zur Eröffnung. Diese zentrale Rolle, die den Hauptsitz und die regionalen Verantwortlichkeiten verbindet, gewährleistet sowohl die Markenerwünschtheit durch Design-Exzellenz als auch die Markenproduktivität durch betriebliche Effizienz, Qualität, Kostenkontrolle und Nachhaltigkeit. Sie sind maßgeblich an der Umsetzung des Einzelhandelsentwicklungs- und -renovierungsprogramms der Region beteiligt und halten die Markenerwünschtheit, die Ausführungsqualität, die Projektplanung, das Budget und die Nachhaltigkeitsverpflichtungen ein. Regelmäßige Reisen durch Frankreich, die Schweiz, Italien und die nordischen Länder sind für Standortbewertungen und die Projektaufsicht unerlässlich. SCHLÜSSELVERANTWORTUNGEN: Koordinieren Sie die Designentwicklung vom Konzept bis zur Baudokumentation und gewährleisten Sie die Konsistenz mit den architektonischen Standards und der Markenidentität von Piaget. Verwalten Sie externe Design-Spezialisten (Architekten, 3D-Künstler, Berater). Arbeiten Sie mit den Teams von HQ Retail, VM und Commercial zusammen, um die Einzelhandelserfahrung und die betriebliche Effizienz zu optimieren. Budgetierung, Planung und Bau: Führen Sie Projekte von der Investitionsvalidierung über Bau und Close-Out, Entwicklung und Steuerung von Budgets, CAPEX und Planung. Fahre Ausschreibungen, technische Bewertungen, kommerzielle Verhandlungen und Auftragsvergaben. Verwalten Sie Beschaffung, Kaufaufträge, Änderungsaufträge und Finanzberichterstattung. Koordinieren Sie Genehmigungen, Vermietergenehmigungen und lokale Behördenbeziehungen. Handeln Sie als wichtiger Stakeholder mit Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal und externen Partnern während des gesamten Projekts. Verwalten Sie alle Bauphasen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die Projekte pünktlich, im Rahmen des Budgets und nach den Qualitäts- und Nachhaltigkeitsstandards von Piaget geliefert werden. Risikomanagement: Identifizieren Sie Projektrisiken und implementieren Sie Minderungs- und Wiederherstellungspläne. Wartung: Koordinieren Sie regionale Wartungs- und Nacheröffnungsprogramme, einschließlich Snagging, Nachrüstprojekte und kleinere Arbeiten. Pflegen Sie regelmäßige Kommunikation mit kommerziellen Teams und Boutique-Direktoren in ganz Europa. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Standards, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeitsziele der Marke Piaget. Transversales Management: Funktioniert als primäre HQ-Schnittstelle für die Region Europa und koordiniert regionale Märkte für den Bau und die Wartung von Boutiquen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (Einzelhandel, Beschaffung, Immobilien, Recht, Finanzen, Sicherheit, VM, Inhalte) und Aufbau starker Beziehungen zu externen Partnern (Vermieter, Berater, Auftragnehmer). WIE WIRST IHR ERFAHREN MIT UNS? Erfahrung: Mindestens 10 Jahre in Architektur, Innenarchitektur oder Bauprojektmanagement, mit mindestens 7 Jahren speziell in Luxusgeschäft Planung und Bau. Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Bereitstellung internationaler Einzelhandelsprojekte innerhalb der Luxusbranche oder Premiummarken. Solides Verständnis von Luxusdesign, Bauprozessen und operativer Exzellenz. Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Management von Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, Generalunternehmern und Fachberatern. Starke Kenntnisse in Beschaffung, Ausschreibungsmanagement, Handelsverhandlungen und Kostenkontrolle. Technische Kompetenzen: Außergewöhnliche analytische, Planungs- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten. Herausragende Kommunikation, Präsentation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten. Kenntnisse in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite und erweiterten Kenntnissen der Microsoft Office Suite. Professionelle Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch und Französisch sind unerlässlich; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein wichtiger Vorteil. Starkes kommerzielles Bewusstsein, nachgewiesenes Verhandlungsgeschick und Baukosten-Know-how. Soft Skills: Kreativ, lösungsorientiert und leidenschaftlich für Luxus-Einzelhandelsumgebungen, Architektur und Designtrends. Hervorragende Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, effektiv in multikulturellen Teams. Agile, anpassungsfähig und geschickt im Management sich verändernder Prioritäten und komplexer Stakeholder-Landschaften. Starker Entscheidungsträger mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Verantwortlichkeit und einer ergebnisorientierten, kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmentalität. Hoch organisiert, proaktiv und in der Lage, gleichzeitig mehrere strategische Projekte zu verwalten. WUNDERUNG WARUM SIE ANWENDEN SOLLTEN? Ein Willkommensteam: Treten Sie unserem freundlichen, aufgeschlossenen und talentierten Team bei, in dem Ihre Fähigkeiten geschätzt werden und Ihre Beiträge einen echten Unterschied machen. Dynamische und engagierte Arbeit: Erleben Sie tägliche Aktivitäten, die interessant, herausfordernd und vielfältig sind und Sie engagiert und motiviert halten. Investition in Ihr Wachstum: Wir sind leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, unsere Mitarbeiter zu entwickeln, und Sie haben Zugang zu verschiedenen Schulungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um Ihre Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und Ihre Karriere voranzutreiben. Die Piaget-Kultur der Förderung von Extra-Care, der Förderung der Meisterschaft und der Hervorbringung des Außerordentlichen in unserem Volk bedeutet, dass wir immer weiter gehen und tun werden, "was noch nie zuvor getan wurde". Gemeinsam. Wenn Sie ein Teil davon werden wollen, zögern Sie nicht, sich zu bewerben!
